_note: Minda Corporation reports one operating segment under Ind AS 108 (automobile components). It discloses revenue for two business verticals in its investor presentations (Rs crore, consolidated): Mechatronics, Aftermarket and Others (vehicle access incl. Minda Vast from Q1FY27, die casting, aftermarket, EV systems) and Information & Connected Systems (wiring harness, instrument clusters, sensors). No vertical profit is disclosed. Q2FY25 is derived as FY25 less Q1, Q3 and Q4 as disclosed; Q2FY26 as FY26 less the other three quarters. Q1FY27 Mechatronics includes ~Rs125 cr from Minda Vast (consolidated from 1-Apr-2026).
